# Required status checks on `main` (issue #904).
#
# This file is the single source of truth for the branch-protection
# required-context list. It is meant to mirror the live setting:
#
#   gh api repos/joshjhall/containers/branches/main/protection \
#     --jq '.required_status_checks.contexts'
#
# It is guarded by tests/unit/required-checks.sh, which asserts every name here
# still matches a job that reports on EVERY pull request to `main`.
#
# STATUS: not yet applied — `main` is still unprotected. Applying needs a token
# with the repo "Administration: Read and write" permission. See
# docs/troubleshooting/ci-cd-issues.md for the exact PUT payload.
#
# Why a manifest instead of inlining the names in the test: branch protection
# lives in repo settings, invisible to any diff. This file is the only in-repo
# trace of the intended setting, and it keeps the test and the applied settings
# from drifting apart independently.
#
# Adding a context here does NOT apply it — update the live setting too. And
# only add checks that report on every PR regardless of what changed: a
# required context that never reports blocks `main` indefinitely (the mirror
# image of #854, which this protection exists to fix). A job that RUNS and
# concludes `SKIPPED` does satisfy a required context; a job that is never
# scheduled at all reports nothing and blocks forever.
#
# Format: one context name per line. `#` comments and blank lines ignored.
